column1: # bios-r2-x001.tsv -- DUMPBIOS disk round, closing table for BIOS-STOR-001:
# a CHANGED logical sector 0 written without RW_NOMEDIACH, against EmuTOS
# 1a7484ab (docs/analysis/ORACLE.md; TASK/BIOS01, docs/api/bios/04-rwabs.md,
# docs/audits/2026-10-28-bios-storage.md).  EmuTOS arms forcechange
# (bios/blkdev.c:452-453) and then fails the same call in its media-change
# test (blkdev.c:473-477, blkdev_mediach :802-803): E_CHNG, NOTHING WRITTEN.
# bios-r2.tsv W01 measures the return of that write, but it writes back the
# bytes it read, so the image cannot tell whether it reached the disk; here
# the buffer differs from the disk in one byte (the OEM name at offset 3, no
# BPB field), so a write that goes through shows in the end state and in the
# last case's capture.
# WHERE IT RUNS -- as bios-r2.tsv: the oracle's profile disk
# (HATARI_ORACLE_DISK=<test.img> tools/hatari-oracle.sh disk ...) and on NewTOS
# a card from tools/mkcard.sh with MKCARD_TESTDISK (cargo xtask tosdump bios
# --disk ...). The test image: tools/mktestdisk.sh
# NEWDESK.INF=<inf>, the one of bios-r2.tsv (sha256 d95a60c3...); C: = LBA 63,
# DESTRUCTIVE ("!disk 2 destructive", docs/TOS-REFERENCE-DUMPER.md section 6,
# "The closing tables") because its write carries changed bytes ("+set"); it
# runs on a fresh clone of the test image only (the runners refuse
# otherwise), and both sides must END in the same state: the test partitions
# after the run are compared (RUNINFO of the run).
#   End state: the test partition as before the run (the write is refused).
# One table per round: a case id is the physical line number and the dump
# header carries the CRC of this file, so it is frozen once measured.
!disk

column5: Getbpb(2) before: the image's BPB -- blkdev.c:569-777

column1: # ---- the write: sector 0 with OEM name byte 3 'M' (0x4D) -> 'X' (0x58)
+set

column5: X17 write the changed sector 0, no RW_NOMEDIACH: E_CHNG, nothing written -- blkdev.c:450-453, 473-477
X17a Mediach(2) after it: forcechange -- blkdev.c:799-803
X17b read sector 0 while armed: E_CHNG, buffer untouched -- blkdev.c:450-451
X17c Getbpb(2): the image's BPB, clears forcechange -- blkdev.c:589-590
X17e read sector 0: byte 3 is the image's 'M', not 'X' -- blkdev.c:430-481
